# generate merged set with NA's

# recoding EU
```{r}
df_all_eu4 <- df_all_eu3 %>% 
 mutate (P_AGE= ifelse(P_AGE == ">89", "90", P_AGE),
           P_AGE1= as.numeric(P_AGE),
           CG_AGE= ifelse(CG_AGE == ">89", "90", CG_AGE),
           CG_AGE2= as.numeric(CG_AGE),
          P_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(P_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 65 & P_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 75 & P_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          CG_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(CG_AGE2 <65, "1", ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 65 & CG_AGE2 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 75 & CG_AGE2 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          P_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(P_SEX == "Male" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_SEX== "Male" , "1", "2")), 
         P_EDUC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_EDUC <= 12, "1", "2")),
         CG_OTHCG1=as.factor(ifelse(CG_OTHCG==0, "0", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 2, "2", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         SEVGRP= as.factor(SEVGRPCD),
         CG_LIVEIN1= as.factor (ifelse(CG_LIVEIN == "Yes" , "1", "2")),
         CG_REL1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_REL %in% c("Husband", "Wife"), 1, ifelse(CG_REL == "Child", 2, 3)))) %>%
dplyr::select(SUBJID, COUNTRY, P_SEX1, P_AGE1, CG_AGE2,CG_SEX1, CG_LIVEIN1, CG_OTHCG1, CG_REL1, ZBITOTB, COST_COSTCAINM, P_AGECAT, CG_AGECAT, P_EDUC1, MMSETOTB, cmbdts)
dim(df_all_eu4)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(df_all_eu4))
```

# recoding US
```{r}
df_all_us3_mildAD <- df_all_us2_mildAD %>% 
  mutate (P_AGE = ifelse(P_AGE == ">89", "90", P_AGE),
          P_AGE1=  as.numeric(P_AGE),
          CG_AGE = ifelse(CG_AGE == ">89", "90", CG_AGE),  
          CG_AGE1= as.numeric(CG_AGE),
          P_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(P_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 65 & P_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 75 & P_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          CG_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(CG_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(CG_AGE1 >= 65 & CG_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(CG_AGE1 >= 75 & CG_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          P_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(P_SEX == "1" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_SEX== "1" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_OTHCG1=as.factor(ifelse(CG_OTHCG==0, "0", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 2, "2", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         CG_LIVEIN1= as.factor (ifelse(CG_LIVEIN == "1" , "1", "2")),
         #P_EDUC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_EDUC %in% c(1,2,3,4), "1", "2")),
         P_EDUC1 = as.factor(case_when(
                    P_EDUC %in% c(1,2,3,4) ~ "1",
                    P_EDUC > 4 ~ "2",
                    TRUE ~ NA_character_
                  )),
         SEVGRP = case_when(MMSETOTB >=21 ~ 1, MMSETOTB >= 15 & MMSETOTB <= 20 ~ 2, MMSETOTB <= 14 ~ 3),
         COST_COSTCAINM = round(COST_COSTCAINM, digits = 2),
         CG_REL1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_REL== 1, 1, ifelse(CG_REL == 3 , 2, 3)))) %>%
select(SUBJID, COUNTRY,  P_SEX1, P_AGE1, P_AGECAT, P_EDUC1,  CG_AGE1, CG_AGECAT, CG_SEX1, CG_LIVEIN1, CG_OTHCG1, CG_REL1, ZBITOTB, MMSETOTB, COST_COSTCAINM, cmbdts)
dim(df_all_us3_mildAD)  
```

```{r}
df_all_us3_mildAD <- df_all_us3_mildAD %>%
  rename(CG_AGE2 = CG_AGE1)
```

# recoding JP
```{r}
df_all_jp3 <- df_all_jp2 %>%
  mutate (P_AGE = ifelse(C_AGE == ">89", "90", C_AGE),
          P_AGE1 = as.numeric(P_AGE),
          CG_AGE1 = ifelse(C_CGAGE == ">89", "90", C_CGAGE),
          CG_AGE2 = as.numeric(CG_AGE1),
          P_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(P_AGE1 <65, "1", ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 65 & P_AGE1 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(P_AGE1 >= 75 & P_AGE1 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
          CG_AGECAT= as.factor(ifelse(CG_AGE2 <65, "1", ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 65 & CG_AGE2 <= 74, "2",  ifelse(CG_AGE2 >= 75 & CG_AGE2 <= 84, "3", "4")))),
         P_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(P_SEX == "0" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_SEX1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_SEX== "0" , "1", "2")), 
         CG_OTHCG1=as.factor(ifelse(CG_OTHCG==0, "0", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 2, "2", ifelse(CG_OTHCG == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         P_CC1=as.factor(ifelse(P_CC==0, "0", ifelse(P_CC == 1, "1", ifelse(P_CC == 2, "2", ifelse(P_CC == 3, "3", "4"))))),
         CG_LIVEIN1= as.factor (ifelse(CG_LIVEIN == "Y" , "1", "2")),
         SEVGRP= as.factor(ifelse(SEVGEUCD == 1, "1", ifelse(SEVGEUCD == 2, "2", "3"))),
         P_EDUC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_EDUC %in% c(1,2), "1", "2")),
         P_LIVLOC1= as.factor(ifelse(P_LIVLOC == 1, "1", "2")),
         P_ALONE1= as.factor(ifelse(P_ALONE == 0, "0", "1")),
         P_MARRIED1= as.factor(ifelse(P_MARRIED == 0, "0", "1")),
         CG_REL1= as.factor(ifelse(CG_REL == 1, "1", ifelse(CG_REL == 2, "2", "3")))) %>% 
dplyr::select(SUBJID, COUNTRY, P_SEX1, P_AGE1, P_AGECAT, P_EDUC1, CG_AGE2, CG_AGECAT, CG_SEX1, CG_LIVEIN1, CG_OTHCG1, CG_REL1, COST_COSTCAINM, ZBITOTB, MMSETOTB, cmbdts)
 
  
dim(df_all_jp3)
```

```{r}
colSums(is.na(df_all_jp3))
```

```{r}
df_list <- list(df_all_eu4, df_all_it3, df_all_sp3, df_all_jp3, df_all_us3_mildAD)
```

# currency
# Currencies for US and Japan are in USD. The currencies for Spain, Italy and GERAS-EU are available in Euro. We converted the currency Euroes to USD for Spain and Italy datasets to merge all four datasets effectively. 

# dollar conversion
```{r}
# index year 2020
IF_rate <- c(
# inflation factor for USA:
1.0596063,
# inflation factor for JPN: 
1.0144817,
# inflation factor for ESP: 
1.0303351,
# inflation factor for ITA: 
1.0293441,
# inflation factor for FRA: 
1.0005241,
# inflation factor for DEU: 
.99505091,
# inflation factor for GBR: 
1.008787
)

names(IF_rate) <- c("US", "JP", "SP", "IT", "FR", "DE", "UK")

US_rate <- c(1, 1, 1.14, 1.14, 1.14, 1.14, 1.14)

names(US_rate) <- c("US", "JP", "SP", "IT", "FR", "DE", "UK")

```

# convert to US dollar in 2020
```{r}
df_combined$COST_COSTCAINM_orig <- df_combined$COST_COSTCAINM
```


```{r}
df_combined2 <- df_combined %>% 
  mutate(COST_COSTCAINM = ifelse(COUNTRY == "FRANCE", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["FR"] * US_rate["FR"], ifelse(COUNTRY == "GERMANY", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["DE"] * US_rate["DE"], 
ifelse(COUNTRY == "UNITED KINGDOM", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["UK"] * US_rate["UK"],                    ifelse(COUNTRY == "ITALY", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["IT"] * US_rate["IT"],                    ifelse(COUNTRY == "SPAIN", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["SP"] * US_rate["SP"],                    ifelse(COUNTRY == "US", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["US"] * US_rate["US"],
ifelse(COUNTRY == "Japan", COST_COSTCAINM_orig * IF_rate["JP"] * US_rate["JP"],
COST_COSTCAINM_orig))))))))
  
```



```{r}
save(df_combined2, file = paste0(datadir,"df_all_w_NAs.RData"))
```
